}}'''Jameine''' is a [[seamstress]] in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jameine}}

==Appearance==
Jameine is a willowy and hot-eyed woman. According to [[Olver]], she has a graceful neck like a swan.{{ref/book|9|15}}

==Activities==
Jameine is one of several women who has taken an interest in Olver. When he leaves the show with [[Matrim Cauthon]], Olver spends time with Jameine, [[Adria]], [[Gillin]], [[Merici]] and [[Neilyn]].{{ref/book|9|15}} In continuing with [[Petra Anhill]]'s roll as protecter in the show, he breaks up a fight over Jameine.{{ref/book|10|3}}
